title: Technical Architect / Manager / Lead - DBMS
description:
Role & Responsibility :

- Single-handed hands-on MultiHat Role - With end-to-end Technology Development from Technology planning map, Technology Architecture Development -Implementation, Technology Platform Development, DBMS, B2B & B2B2C SaaS Cloud Platform maintenance, server-side, DB, client-side to build from Scratch a Highly Scalable Digital Health Platform or an E-Commerce Platform.

- Understanding of Full Stack Technology Development will be required to see out a project from conception to final product, requiring good organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Their primary responsibilities include designing user interactions on the web portal or app, developing AWS Cloud servers and databases for the web portal and mobile app functionality, and coding for mobile platforms.

- Developing front-end web Portal architecture.

- Designing user interactions on web pages.

- Developing back-end web Portal applications.

- Creating servers and databases for functionality.

- Ensuring cross-platform optimization for mobile phones.

- Ensuring responsiveness of applications.

- Working alongside graphic designers for web design features.

- Seeing through a project from conception to finished product.

- Designing and developing APIs.

- Meeting both technical and consumer needs.

- Staying abreast of developments in web applications and programming languages.

- Testing using the latest Tools.

- DevOps Engineering Skillsets added advantage.

4) Qualification : B. Tech ( EE, CSE, ECE, IT) from reputed Technology Institute.

5) Experience :

- Total of 10 Years in Hardcore Software Product Development Engineering at various levels in an E-Commerce Early to Growth stage Tech Startup. 

- Including 4 years as Technical Architect Tech Architect Lead Role responsibility.

- 2 to 6 Years Experience as a Full-stack Developer in web and Mobile application Software Product Engineering Post Education Qualification.

- Should have worked single-handedly and as a Team member and as a leader with multi-hat roles & in the team as a Backend developer, Database experienced in QA Testing on web and mobile apps in an early-stage startup company.

- Strong organizational and project management skills.

- Full-stack development with hands-on as a single-handed and multi-role in early-stage Digital Health Startup preferably or in an Early Stage E-commerce marketplace Tech Startup in any other Industry. Worked from scratch in the Tech Architect, frontend, coding, and Tech product development with at least 20 -50 Mobile apps ( multifunction apps) with at least 10000 to 500,000 Downloads of his Product developed.

Should have Skillsets as follows :

- Proficiency with fundamental front-end languages such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

- Familiarity with JavaScript frameworks such as Angular JS, React, and Amber.

- Django, Dynamo DB, LAMP, MEAN stack

- AWS ( AWS S3, EC2, Amazon Device Farm), Android, Kotlin, React, react-native Flutter, dart ios, Swift, Google-Firebase.

- Should have additional skills No SQL DB, Mongo DB but not mandatory.

- Proficiency with server-side languages such as Python, Ruby, Java, PHP, .Net & Tensor flow.

- Familiarity with database technology such as MySQL, Oracle, and MongoDB.

- You should have worked in a single-handed multi-hat role & responsibility in software product development engineering in a startup preferably in early-stage Digital Health, E-commerce, or any other Industry additionally with multi-hat role hands-on software skills and hands-on single-handed.

Key Skills: JavaScript,Java,CSS,HTML,MEAN stack,Android,Kotlin,Django
